curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42071-1-1.pdf (the dozer compactor: steering gears steps 6-11, blade worm and gear steps 41-46, blade steps 53-61, functions page 48); 42071-1-2.pdf builds the alternate model

functions.does: The upright axle behind the cab steers the compactor by bending it in the middle: its 12 tooth bevel gear turns a 20 tooth bevel gear that turns the turntable carrying the front half.
functions.source: book: steps 6-11 (gears and turntable), page 48 (top inset: the knob behind the cab, the front half swinging)

functions.does: The upright axle in front of the cab raises and lowers the blade: a worm at its foot turns the 20 tooth gear on the blade arms' axle, and links from the front axle keep the blade upright as it rises.
functions.source: book: steps 41-46 (worm and 20 tooth gear), 53-61 (blade and links), page 48 (lower inset: the knob in front of the cab, the blade swinging up)

functions.does: The four spiked compactor wheels roll freely; there is no drive.
